miss_rate.value: 38/126 = 30.2% (verified; both auditors); up to 46/134 = 34.3% with 8 unverified
miss_rate.note: The blind list audit ran in parallel with the finders this time, so every verified miss was added before profiling was chosen. Two-list (capture-recapture) estimate of the population the auditors' search methods reach: about 132 plants; auditor A found 93 and auditor B 94 of the ledger's included plants, 66 in common. The ledger's 203 included plants contain all of them plus suppliers and fabricators outside the auditors' search angles. Misses were mostly small attachment and bucket makers, paving machine makers, aggregate equipment makers and mining service fabricators.
